         2                      THE PRESIDENT:  The Senate will

         4                      I'd like to ask everyone present

         9                      Please be seated.

        10                      The invocation today will be

        11       given by the Right Reverend David S. Ball,

        12       Bishop of the Episcopal Diocese of Albany.

        13       Reverend Ball -- Bishop Ball.

        14                      BISHOP BALL:  Thank you.  Instead

        15       of saying a brief prayer for the Senate, I'm

        16       going to offer a more inclusive prayer for the

        17       common life in this country of ours.

        18                      Almighty God, You have given us

        19       this good land for our heritage.  We humbly

        20       beseech You that we may always prove ourselves a

        21       people mindful of Your favor and glad to do Your

        22       will.  Bless our land with honorable industry,

        23       sound learning and pure manners.  Save us from











                                                              3

         1       violence, discord and confusion, from pride and

         2       arrogance and from every evil way.  Defend our

         3       liberties and fashion into one united people the

         4       multitudes brought here out of many places and

         5       tongues.  Imbue the spirit of wisdom those to

         6       whom in Your name we entrust the authority of

         7       government, especially members of this Senate,

         8       that there may be justice and peace at home and

         9       that, through obedience to Your law, we may show

        10       forth Your praise among the nations of the

        11       earth.  In the time of prosperity, fill our

        12       hearts with thankfulness and in the day of

        13       trouble, suffer not our trust in You to fall or

        14       to fail.  We ask these things in Your holy and

        15       life-giving name.  Amen.

        16                      Thank you, Governor.

        17                      THE PRESIDENT:  Thank you very
